title: The Diatessaron (Section 32)
breadcrumbs: Home > Fathers of the Church > The Diatessaron (Tatian) > Section 32

paragraphs.text: 1 And when Jesus entered Jerusalem, he went up to the temple of God, and found 2 there oxen and sheep and doves. {{BIBLE:mat 21:12}} And when he beheld those that sold and those that bought, and the money-changers sitting, {{BIBLE:joh 2:14}} he made for himself a scourge of rope, and drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep and the oxen, and the money-changers; {{BIBLE:mat 21:12}} and he threw down their money, and upset their tables, and the seats of 3 them that sold the doves; {{BIBLE:mat 21:13}} and he was teaching, and saying unto them, Is it not written, My house is a house of prayer for all peoples? And you have made it a den 4 for robbers. {{BIBLE:joh 2:16}} And he said unto those that sold the doves, Take this hence, and 5 make not my Father's house a house of merchandise. {{BIBLE:mar 11:16}} And he suffered not any 6 one to carry vessels inside the temple. {{BIBLE:joh 2:17}} And his disciples remembered the scripture, 7 The zeal of your house has eaten me up. {{BIBLE:joh 2:18}} The Jews answered and said unto him, 8 What sign have you shown us, that you do this? {{BIBLE:joh 2:19}} Jesus answered and said unto 9 them, Destroy this temple, and I shall raise it in three days. {{BIBLE:joh 2:20}} The Jews said unto him, This temple was built in forty-six years, and will you raise it in three days? 10 {{BIBLE:joh 2:21}} But he spoke unto them of the temple of his body, that when they destroyed it, he 11 [Arabic, p. 122] would raise it in three days. {{BIBLE:joh 2:22}} When therefore he rose from among the dead, his disciples remembered that he said this; and they believed the scriptures, and the word that Jesus spoke.

12 {{BIBLE:mar 12:41}} And when Jesus sat down over against the treasury, he observed how the multitudes were casting their offerings into the treasury: and many rich men were 13, 14 throwing in much. {{BIBLE:mar 12:42}} And there came a poor widow, and cast in two mites. {{BIBLE:luk 21:3}} And Jesus called his disciples, and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, This poor 15 widow cast into the treasury more than all the people: {{BIBLE:mar 12:44}} and all of these cast into the place of the offering of God of the superfluity of their wealth; while this woman of her want threw in all that she possessed.

16 {{BIBLE:luk 18:9}} And he spoke unto them this parable, concerning people who trusted in themselves 17 that they are righteous, and despised every man: {{BIBLE:luk 18:10}} Two men went up to the 18 temple to pray; one of them a Pharisee, and the other a publican. {{BIBLE:luk 18:11}} And the Pharisee stood apart, and prayed thus, O Lord, I thank you, since I am not like the rest of men, the unjust, the profligate, the extortioners, or even like this publican; 19 {{BIBLE:luk 18:12}} but I fast two days a week, and tithe all my possessions. {{BIBLE:luk 18:13}} And the publican was 20 standing at a distance, and he would not even lift up his eyes to heaven, but was 21 beating upon his breast, and saying, O Lord, have mercy on me, me the sinner. {{BIBLE:luk 18:14}} I say unto you, that this man went down justified to his house more than the Pharisee. Every one that exalts himself shall be abased; and every one that abases himself shall be exalted.

22 [Arabic, p. 123] And when eventide had come, he left all the people, and went outside the 23 city to Bethany, he and his twelve, and he remained there. {{BIBLE:luk 9:11}} And all the people, because they knew the place, came to him, and he received them; and them that 24 had need of healing he healed. {{BIBLE:mar 11:12}} And on the morning of the next day, when he returned 25 to the city from Bethany, he hungered. {{BIBLE:mar 11:13}} And he saw a fig tree at a distance on the beaten highway, having on it leaves. And he came unto it, expecting to find something on it; and when he came, he found nothing on it but the leaves— it was not 26 the season of figs— {{BIBLE:mar 11:14}} and he said unto it, Henceforward for ever let no man eat fruit of you. And his disciples heard.

27 And they came to Jerusalem. And there was there a man of the Pharisees, 28 named Nicodemus, ruler of the Jews. {{BIBLE:joh 3:2}} This man came unto Jesus by night, and said unto him, My Master, we know that you have been sent from God as a teacher; and no man can do these signs that you do, except him whom God is 29 with. {{BIBLE:joh 3:3}} Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man 30 be not born a second time, he cannot see the kingdom of God. {{BIBLE:joh 3:4}} Nicodemus said unto him, How can a man who is old be born? Can he, think you, return again to 31 his mother's womb a second time, to enter and be born? {{BIBLE:joh 3:5}} Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man be not born of water and the Spirit, 32 he cannot enter the kingdom of God. {{BIBLE:joh 3:6}} For he that is born of flesh is flesh; and he that 33 is born of Spirit is spirit. {{BIBLE:joh 3:7}} Wonder not that I said unto you that you must be born a 34 [Arabic, p. 124] second time. {{BIBLE:joh 3:8}} The wind blows where it lists, and you hear its voice, but you know not from what place it comes, nor whither it goes: so 35 is every man that is born of the Spirit. {{BIBLE:joh 3:9}} Nicodemus answered and said unto him, 36 How can that be? {{BIBLE:joh 3:10}} Jesus answered and said unto him, Are you teaching Israel, 37 and yet know not these things? {{BIBLE:joh 3:11}} Verily, verily, I say unto you, What we know 38 we say, and what we have seen we witness: and you receive not our witness. {{BIBLE:joh 3:12}} If I said unto you what is on earth, and you believed not, how then, if I say unto you 39 what is in heaven, will you believe? {{BIBLE:joh 3:13}} And no man has ascended up into heaven, except him that descended from heaven, the Son of man, which is in heaven. 40 {{BIBLE:joh 3:14}} And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, so is the Son of man to be 41 lifted up; {{BIBLE:joh 3:15}} so that every man who may believe in him may not perish, but have 42 eternal life. {{BIBLE:joh 3:16}} God so loved the world, that he should give his only Son; and so every one that believes in him should not perish, but should have eternal life. 43 {{BIBLE:joh 3:17}} God sent not his Son into the world to judge the world; but that the world might 44 be saved by his hand. {{BIBLE:joh 3:18}} He that believes in him shall not be judged: but he that believes not is condemned beforehand, because he has not believed in the name 45 of the only Son, the Son of God. {{BIBLE:joh 3:19}} This is the judgement, that the light came into the world, and men loved the darkness more than the light; because their deeds 46 were evil. {{BIBLE:joh 3:20}} Whosoever does evil deeds hates the light, and comes not to the 47 light, lest his deeds be reproved. {{BIBLE:joh 3:21}} But he that does the truth comes to the light, that his deeds may be known, that they have been done in God.
